Objective: 
We are looking for an experienced Tech Lead. The Tech Lead will be responsible for overseeing the technical 
aspects of software development projects, guiding development teams, ensuring the quality of code, and 
providing technical solutions to complex challenges. This role combines leadership, codi ng expertise, and the 
ability to make strategic decisions that align with business goals and technical requirements. 
 
Key Responsibilities: 
• Technical Leadership & Mentorship: 
o Lead and mentor a team of developers, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture. 
o Provide technical guidance to team members and ensure that best practices are followed 
throughout the software development lifecycle. 
o Conduct regular code reviews and provide constructive feedback to ensure code quality and 
adherence to standards. 
o Assist with the resolution of complex technical issues, helping the team navigate challenges and 
obstacles. 
• Architecture & Design: 
o Collaborate with Solution Architects, product managers, and other stakeholders to design 
scalable, secure, and efficient technical solutions. 
o Take ownership of technical designs, ensuring they are aligned with business goals, system 
requirements, and technical constraints. 
o Ensure that the team is following established architecture and design patterns, while also 
exploring opportunities for optimization and innovation. 
• Project Delivery: 
o Oversee the technical execution of projects, ensuring tasks are delivered on time, within scope, 
and to a high standard of quality. 
o Act as a point of escalation for technical challenges, providing solutions and coordinating with 
other departments to ensure successful project delivery. 
o Work with the project management team to estimate timelines, prioritize tasks, and ensure that 
the development process is well-organized and efficient. 
• Collaboration & Communication: 
o Serve as a key liaison between technical and non -technical teams, ensuring that requirements, 
constraints, and progress are clearly communicated. 
o Work closely with cross-functional teams including business analysts, QA, operations, and product 
managers to ensure seamless project execution. 
o Participate in sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring alignment across teams and 
helping to drive agile best practices. 
• Continuous Improvement: 
o Identify opportunities for process improvement, ensuring that the team follows agile best 
practices and continuously improves development workflows. 
o Encourage innovation, driving the team to explore new tools, frameworks, and technologies to 
improve product performance and scalability. 
o Promote a culture of learning and development by encouraging the team to pursue new skills, 
technologies, and certifications. 
• Quality Assurance & Testing: 
o Ensure that the development team follows testing practices such as unit testing, integration 
testing, and automated testing. 
o Help drive quality throughout the development lifecycle by ensuring the team maintains high 
standards of code quality and reliability. 
o Collaborate with the QA team to ensure proper testing coverage and timely resolution of bugs. 
 
 
 
 
Qualifications: 
• Education: 
o Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 
Desired 
o Relevant certifications (e.g., AWS, Azure, Scrum Master) are a plus. 
• Experience: 
o 8-10 years of experience in software development, with at least 8 years in a leadership or senior 
developer role. 
o Proven experience leading development teams in a technical capacity, preferably in an Agile 
environment. 
o Strong experience with software design and architecture, and deep knowledge of programming 
languages (e.g., Java, Python, C#, JavaScript, etc.). 
• Technical Skills: 
o Proficient in web development frameworks, databases (SQL, NoSQL), cloud computing platforms 
(AWS, Azure, GCP), and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). 
o Strong understanding of version control (e.g., Git), CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing. 
o Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management tools (e.g., JIRA, Trello). 
Desired Skills: 
• Experience with cloud-native application architectures. 
• Familiarity with microservices, event-driven architectures, and serverless computing. 
• Experience with API design and integration (RESTful APIs,). 
• Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation).

About National e-Governance Division (NeGD) 
 
The National e-Governance Division has been set up by the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology 
as an Independent Business Division under the Digital India Corporation {erstwhile Media Lab Asia}. Since 
2009, NeGD has been playing a pivotal role in supporting MeitY in Programme Management and 
implementation of the e -Governance Projects; providing technical and advisory support to Ministries/ 
Departments, both at Central and State levels along with other Government organizations. NeGD’s major 
operational areas include programme management, project development, technology management, capacity 
building, awareness and communications-related activities under the flagship Digital India Programme. NeGD 
has developed and is managing several National Public  Digital Platforms such as DigiLocker, UMANG, Rapid 
Assessment System, OpenForge, API Setu, Poshan Tracker, Academic Bank of Credits, National Academic 
Depositories, National AI Portal, MyScheme, India Stack Global, Meri Pehchaan, etc. 
 
The roles and responsibilities of NeGD are as follows: 
1. Providing strategic direction in terms of framing policies and implementation strategy for the Digital 
India Programme in different domains of e-Governance 
2. Proactive support to Central and State Governments for Mission Mode Projects and other e -
Governance projects 
3. Acting as a facilitator and catalyst for the implementation of the Digital India Program by various 
Ministries and State Governments 
4. Providing technical assistance to Central Ministries/ State Line Departments in their e -Governance 
projects either directly or in collaboration with professional consultants 
5. Undertaking technical appraisal of e-Governance projects for examining issues like overall technology, 
architecture, framework standards, security policy, service delivery mechanism, sharing of common 
infrastructure, etc 
6. Developing generic / model Expression of Interest, Request for Proposal, Standard Contracts, PPP 
Models and other related documents for various stages and requirements of projects for use by the 
States 
7. Ensuring effective citizen engagement and communication with all stakeholders using offline and 
Social Media channels 
8. Impact assessment of e-governance projects of all States / UTs 
9. Recruitment, deployment and HR management of specialised resources in the State e -Governance 
Mission Teams in all States and UTs 
10. Enhancing governance through knowledge and capacity building 
 
More details can be seen at https://negd.gov.in/. 
 
 
 
 
About Digital India Corporation (DIC) 
 
The Digital India Corporation (formerly Media Lab Asia) has been set up by the Ministry of Electronics and 
Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India, to innovate, develop and deploy ICT and other 
emerging technologies for the benefit of the common man. Digital India Corporation plays the role of a leader 
in promoting e-Governance by taking forward the projects and activities of the Digital India Programme, to 
facilitate its stakeholders to realise its goals. It also provides strategic support to M inistries & Departments, 
both at the Central and State level for carrying forward the mission of the Digital India Programme by way of 
Capacity Building for e -Governance projects, promoting best practices, encouraging Public -Private 
Partnerships (PPP), nurturing innovation and technology in various domains.  
 
Digital India Corporation has several Independent Business Divisions under it and these include NeGD, MyGov, 
Bhashini, ISM, IndiaAI and MSH. 
 
Digital India Corporation entails following responsibilities: 
1. To provide leadership and support to the Government of India through MeitY; to steer and anchor the 
Digital India Programme along with related policy and implementation initiatives. 
2. To support MeitY about policy and implementation -related issues concerning various ongoing 
programmes & schemes in the ICT domain as well as new initiatives undertaken as part of the Digital 
India Programme. 
3. To support Ministries/Departments, both at Centre and States, as well as other stakeholders in crafting 
e-Governance strategies, to further promote Accountability, Efficiency, Efficacy and Transparency. 
4. To source talent and resources both from the market as well as within Government in the ICT domain 
to Ministries/ Departments on a chargeable basis under Central & State Government; a talent pool of 
technically skilled manpower for hardware, software, netw orks, cyber security and laws, standards, 
quality and testing, etc 
5. To promote innovation and evolve models for the empowerment of citizens and also to promote 
participatory governance and citizen engagement across the government through various platforms 
including social media. 
6. Each IBD under DIC has specific roles and responsibilities and operates independently for its 
operations under the umbrella company of DIC. 
 
More details can be seen at https://dic.gov.in/ 
 
 
 
 
 
About UMANG Project 
 
The Unified Mobile Application for New -age Governance (UMANG) is a flagship initiative under the Digital 
India Programme, developed and managed by the National e-Governance Division (NeGD). UMANG is a unified 
portal aggregating major citizen-centric services of central and state governments and local, autonomous, & 
statutory bodies through mobile apps (Android & iOS) and the web. It is a Digital India initiative intending to 
improve ease of living by putting power in the hands of citizens to avail major gov ernment services anytime, 
anywhere, with just a few clicks on a single mobile app. 
 
The government’s vision is to position UMANG as a single interface for citizens to interact with the 
government, be it services, beneficiary schemes, documents, information, engagement/participation in 
governance, and much more. 
 
UMANG currently hosts thousands of services across sectors such as health, education, finance, utilities, social 
welfare, and employment, and serves millions of registered users nationwide. The platform is mission-critical 
and requires continuous technical  support, enhancement, security monitoring, and onboarding of new 
services. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
1. Job Title / Designation: Full Stack (AI) Developer

• Strong experience in Angular and React.js for developing dynamic, responsive, scalable, and high -
performance web applications. 
• Proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern frontend development practices. 
• Strong backend development experience with Node.js, Express.js, and NestJS, including REST API

JWT, and secure application architectures.

• Good understanding of LangChain and LangGraph, including AI agents, tool calling, workflow orchestration,

• Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Agile/Scrum, automated testing, code reviews, deployment, 
and application performance optimization. 
• Ability to independently design, develop, integrate, and deliver end -to-end full -stack and AI -powered 
applications, with minimal supervision and strong problem-solving skills. 
 
Experience Criteria  
• 4–6 years of experience in the IT industry, with strong hands -on experience in full -stack application 
development using Angular, React.js, Node.js, Express.js, and NestJS. 
• Proficient in developing scalable backend applications, RESTful APIs, microservices, and server -side 
business logic using Node.js and its frameworks. 
• Hands-on experience with Angular/React JavaScript frameworks, TypeScript, and modern frontend 
development practices. 
• Must have working knowledge of backend architectures, database design, application scalability, 
performance optimization, and emerging technologies. 
• Strong understanding of AI/Generative AI, LLMs, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG architecture, vector 
databases, embeddings, AI agents, and multi-model integrations. 
• Knowledge of modern authentication and authorization mechanisms, such as JSON Web Tokens (JWT), 
OAuth2, and secure API development. 
• Proficient understanding of relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL, including database design, 
queries, and ORM tools. 
• Hands-on experience with Git, code versioning tools, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development

Job Title / Designation: Business Analyst (Tech BA) 
No. of Vacancies: 1 
Qualification: B.E/ B. Tech/M.Tech/MBA 
 
Overview: 
The job holder will own end -to-end onboarding of Central/State department services on UMANG 
(requirement capture, integration coordination, UAT and go-live). Post go-live, the job holder will monitor and 
ensure that these services run smoothly within agreed SLAs. 
 
The role includes day -to-day monitoring of UMANG services (department’s applications, APIs, access 
credentials and UMANG components), taking faults up with the responsible stakeholder, and restoring 
services quickly with clear status updates to higher authorities. 
 
It is required to perform the following under onboarding activity: 
identify Deptt., Research on G2C services , Collate Contact details , Engage with Deptt. , communication and 
follow-ups, Functional discussion , Technical discussion , Obtain APIs , check endpoints, responses etc , create 
API document , create FRS , create Test Data , track the SDLC , reporting, Make GO-live 
 
Job Description 
On Boarding 
• Build relationships with nodal officers of Central/State departments to identify and prioritise services for 
UMANG. Obtain formal onboarding requests and coordinate with government officials and vendors to take 
the chosen services live. 
• Prepare API document, Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Requirement Specifications 
(FRS), UML, DFDs, wireframe, process flow and user stories for mobile app and API integration, and obtain 
department sign-off before development starts. 
• Review department’s API specifications (REST/SOAP, JSON, check it using postman) and integration design 
with the technical team, and confirm the go -live checklist (sandbox testing, UAT sign -off, security audit, 
hosting readiness, app-store listing). 
• Maintain an onboarding tracker for each department (milestones, owner, target date, status) and escalate 
delays to higher authorities. 
 
Monitoring 
• Interact with the quality audit partner to log testing defects, track their closure by the implementing 
agency, and confirm UAT sign-off before go-live. 
• Bring out regular progress assessment reports with qualitative inputs, flagging deviations, delays and risks 
to higher authorities along with proposed mitigation. 
• Monitor live service health (uptime, API response time, transaction success rate, crash and error trends) 
through agreed dashboards/MIS, and report SLA breaches to stakeholders. 
• Assist in any other work incidental to the monitoring and implementation of UMANG 
• Interaction with SeMT team to get support for state/UT level onboarding. 
 
Support 
• Coordinate with central and state agencies (including their application and hosting teams) whose 
applications are integrated with UMANG, to resolve integration issues. 
• Post delivery of services, keep in touch with departments to resolve operational issues within agreed 
severity-based timelines (P1/P2/P3), and escalate issues that remain unresolved. 
• Develop and manage relationships with integrated departments through regular review meetings, 
understand service-delivery issues, and take steps to improve citizen experience. 
 
 
 
• Ensure that citizen issues/complaints raised through all channels (UMANG helpdesk, social media, Play 
Store/App Store reviews) are logged, assigned and closed within the agreed turnaround time, with root -
cause tracking for recurring issues. 
 
Reporting 
• Prepare reports and presentations for internal and external distribution on project progress, onboarding 
status and service performance, as per the agreed reporting calendar. 
• Track partner agencies' contractual obligations (deliverables, SLAs, penalties) and flag non -compliance 
with supporting evidence. 
• Maintain adherence to project timelines and quality of outputs, and keep version -controlled project 
documentation (BRD, FRS, UAT sign-offs, change requests) as an audit trail. 
 
Experience Criteria 
• 5+ years in software/IT project delivery, including at least 3 years as a Business Analyst or Techno -
functional lead on enterprise or citizen-facing system integration/implementation projects. 
• Working knowledge of APIs (REST/SOAP, JSON), databases (SQL) and the software development lifecycle; 
able to read API specifications (Swagger/OpenAPI) and discuss integration with developers. 
• Proficient in MS Office, MS Project and JIRA (or equivalent) for requirement, defect and task tracking; 
hands-on experience writing BRD/FRS, user stories and UAT test cases. 
• Hands-on experience with Agile development methods and practices (sprint planning, backlog grooming, 
UAT cycles). 
• Proven stakeholder management and coordination with government officials and multiple vendor/partner 
agencies. 
• Strong written and verbal communication (English and Hindi) for preparing reports and presentations for 
senior officials. 
• Must be an AI ready. All possible AI interventions must be explored.  
• Must be expert of MS suits such as Word, Excel, PPT.  
• Must have extensive working knowledge of API, its collections, postman, endpoints, encrypted responses

assessments, undertaking activities fo r building capacities of both Government oﬃcials and other 
stakeholders, and creating mass awareness about schemes and services under the Digital India Programme.

for a period of three year. The details are given below:

About National e-Governance Division (NeGD) 
 
The National e-Governance Division has been set up by the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology 
as an Independent Business Division under the Digital India Corporation {erstwhile Media Lab Asia}. Since 
2009, NeGD has been playing a pivotal role in supporting MeitY in Programme Management and 
implementation of the e -Governance Projects; providing technical and advisory support to Ministries/ 
Departments, both at Central and State levels along with other Government organizations. NeGD’s major 
operational areas include programme management, project development, technology management, capacity 
building, awareness and communications-related activities under the flagship Digital India Programme. NeGD 
has developed and is managing several National Public  Digital Platforms such as DigiLocker, UMANG, Rapid 
Assessment System, OpenForge, API Setu, Poshan Tracker, Academic Bank of Credits, National Academic 
Depositories, National AI Portal, MyScheme, India Stack Global, Meri Pehchaan, etc. 
 
The roles and responsibilities of NeGD are as follows: 
1. Providing strategic direction in terms of framing policies and implementation strategy for the Digital 
India Programme in different domains of e-Governance 
2. Proactive support to Central and State Governments for Mission Mode Projects and other e -
Governance projects 
3. Acting as a facilitator and catalyst for the implementation of the Digital India Program by various 
Ministries and State Governments 
4. Providing technical assistance to Central Ministries/ State Line Departments in their e -Governance 
projects either directly or in collaboration with professional consultants 
5. Undertaking technical appraisal of e-Governance projects for examining issues like overall technology, 
architecture, framework standards, security policy, service delivery mechanism, sharing of common 
infrastructure, etc 
6. Developing generic / model Expression of Interest, Request for Proposal, Standard Contracts, PPP 
Models and other related documents for various stages and requirements of projects for use by the 
States

Social Media channels

Mission Teams in all States and UTs 
10. Enhancing governance through knowledge and capacity building

About Digital India Corporation (DIC) 
 
The Digital India Corporation (formerly Media Lab Asia) has been set up by the Ministry of Electronics and 
Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India, to innovate, develop and deploy ICT and other 
emerging technologies for the benefit of the common man. Digital India Corporation plays the role of a leader 
in promoting e-Governance by taking forward the projects and activities of the Digital India Programme, to 
facilitate its stakeholders to realise its goals. It also provides strategic support to M inistries & Departments, 
both at the Central and State level for carrying forward the mission of the Digital India Programme by way of 
Capacity Building for e -Governance projects, promoting best practices, encouraging Public -Private 
Partnerships (PPP), nurturing innovation and technology in various domains.  
 
Digital India Corporation has several Independent Business Divisions under it and these include NeGD, MyGov, 
Bhashini, ISM, IndiaAI and MSH. 
 
Digital India Corporation entails following responsibilities: 
1. To provide leadership and support to the Government of India through MeitY; to steer and anchor the 
Digital India Programme along with related policy and implementation initiatives. 
2. To support MeitY about policy and implementation -related issues concerning various ongoing 
programmes & schemes in the ICT domain as well as new initiatives undertaken as part of the Digital 
India Programme. 
3. To support Ministries/Departments, both at Centre and States, as well as other stakeholders in crafting 
e-Governance strategies, to further promote Accountability, Efficiency, Efficacy and Transparency. 
4. To source talent and resources both from the market as well as within Government in the ICT domain 
to Ministries/ Departments on a chargeable basis under Central & State Government; a talent pool of 
technically skilled manpower for hardware, software, netw orks, cyber security and laws, standards, 
quality and testing, etc 
5. To promote innovation and evolve models for the empowerment of citizens and also to promote 
participatory governance and citizen engagement across the government through various platforms 
including social media. 
6. Each IBD under DIC has specific roles and responsibilities and operates independently for its 
operations under the umbrella company of DIC. 
 
More details can be seen at https://dic.gov.in/ 
 
 
 
 
 
About UMANG Project 
 
The Unified Mobile Application for New -age Governance (UMANG) is a flagship initiative under the Digital 
India Programme, developed and managed by the National e-Governance Division (NeGD). UMANG is a unified 
portal aggregating major citizen-centric services of central and state governments and local, autonomous, & 
statutory bodies through mobile apps (Android & iOS) and the web. It is a Digital India initiative intending to 
improve ease of living by putting power in the hands of citizens to avail major gov ernment services anytime, 
anywhere, with just a few clicks on a single mobile app. 
 
The government’s vision is to position UMANG as a single interface for citizens to interact with the 
government, be it services, beneficiary schemes, documents, information, engagement/participation in 
governance, and much more. 
 
UMANG currently hosts thousands of services across sectors such as health, education, finance, utilities, social 
welfare, and employment, and serves millions of registered users nationwide. The platform is mission-critical 
and requires continuous technical  support, enhancement, security monitoring, and onboarding of new 
services. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
1. Job Title / Designation: Full Stack (AI) Developer 
No. of Vacancies: 1 
Qualification: B.E/B. Tech./ MCA 
 
Job Description 
• Strong experience in Angular and React.js for developing dynamic, responsive, scalable, and high -
performance web applications. 
• Proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern frontend development practices. 
• Strong backend development experience with Node.js, Express.js, and NestJS, including REST API 
development, microservices, and server-side architecture. 
• Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL, database design, complex queries, indexing, optimization, and ORM tools. 
• Experience in designing and integrating RESTful APIs, third -party services, authentication, authorization, 
JWT, and secure application architectures. 
• Hands-on experience with AI/Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), including integration of 
OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, or similar models. 
• Good understanding of LangChain and LangGraph, including AI agents, tool calling, workflow orchestration, 
prompt engineering, and multi-model integration. 
• Strong understanding of RAG (Retrieval -Augmented Generation) architecture, including embeddings, 
vector databases (Qdrant, Pinecone, etc.), semantic search, document processing, chunking, and retrieval 
strategies. 
• Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Agile/Scrum, automated testing, code reviews, deployment, 
and application performance optimization. 
• Ability to independently design, develop, integrate, and deliver end -to-end full -stack and AI -powered 
applications, with minimal supervision and strong problem-solving skills. 
 
Experience Criteria  
• 4–6 years of experience in the IT industry, with strong hands -on experience in full -stack application 
development using Angular, React.js, Node.js, Express.js, and NestJS. 
• Proficient in developing scalable backend applications, RESTful APIs, microservices, and server -side 
business logic using Node.js and its frameworks. 
• Hands-on experience with Angular/React JavaScript frameworks, TypeScript, and modern frontend 
development practices. 
• Must have working knowledge of backend architectures, database design, application scalability, 
performance optimization, and emerging technologies. 
• Strong understanding of AI/Generative AI, LLMs, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG architecture, vector 
databases, embeddings, AI agents, and multi-model integrations. 
• Knowledge of modern authentication and authorization mechanisms, such as JSON Web Tokens (JWT), 
OAuth2, and secure API development. 
• Proficient understanding of relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL, including database design, 
queries, and ORM tools. 
• Hands-on experience with Git, code versioning tools, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development 
methodologies. 
 
Desirable Certifications & Experience: 
• Experience of working for a government set up/ project is desirable 
• Professional certifications would be a plus  
 
 
 
 
 
Job Title / Designation: Business Analyst (Tech BA) 
No. of Vacancies: 1 
Qualification: B.E/ B. Tech/M.Tech/MBA 
 
Overview: 
The job holder will own end -to-end onboarding of Central/State department services on UMANG 
(requirement capture, integration coordination, UAT and go-live). Post go-live, the job holder will monitor and 
ensure that these services run smoothly within agreed SLAs. 
 
The role includes day -to-day monitoring of UMANG services (department’s applications, APIs, access 
credentials and UMANG components), taking faults up with the responsible stakeholder, and restoring 
services quickly with clear status updates to higher authorities. 
 
It is required to perform the following under onboarding activity: 
identify Deptt., Research on G2C services , Collate Contact details , Engage with Deptt. , communication and 
follow-ups, Functional discussion , Technical discussion , Obtain APIs , check endpoints, responses etc , create 
API document , create FRS , create Test Data , track the SDLC , reporting, Make GO-live 
 
Job Description 
On Boarding 
• Build relationships with nodal officers of Central/State departments to identify and prioritise services for 
UMANG. Obtain formal onboarding requests and coordinate with government officials and vendors to take 
the chosen services live. 
• Prepare API document, Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Requirement Specifications 
(FRS), UML, DFDs, wireframe, process flow and user stories for mobile app and API integration, and obtain 
department sign-off before development starts. 
• Review department’s API specifications (REST/SOAP, JSON, check it using postman) and integration design 
with the technical team, and confirm the go -live checklist (sandbox testing, UAT sign -off, security audit, 
hosting readiness, app-store listing). 
• Maintain an onboarding tracker for each department (milestones, owner, target date, status) and escalate 
delays to higher authorities. 
 
Monitoring 
• Interact with the quality audit partner to log testing defects, track their closure by the implementing 
agency, and confirm UAT sign-off before go-live. 
• Bring out regular progress assessment reports with qualitative inputs, flagging deviations, delays and risks 
to higher authorities along with proposed mitigation. 
• Monitor live service health (uptime, API response time, transaction success rate, crash and error trends) 
through agreed dashboards/MIS, and report SLA breaches to stakeholders. 
• Assist in any other work incidental to the monitoring and implementation of UMANG 
• Interaction with SeMT team to get support for state/UT level onboarding. 
 
Support 
• Coordinate with central and state agencies (including their application and hosting teams) whose 
applications are integrated with UMANG, to resolve integration issues. 
• Post delivery of services, keep in touch with departments to resolve operational issues within agreed 
severity-based timelines (P1/P2/P3), and escalate issues that remain unresolved. 
• Develop and manage relationships with integrated departments through regular review meetings, 
understand service-delivery issues, and take steps to improve citizen experience. 
 
 
 
• Ensure that citizen issues/complaints raised through all channels (UMANG helpdesk, social media, Play 
Store/App Store reviews) are logged, assigned and closed within the agreed turnaround time, with root -
cause tracking for recurring issues. 
 
Reporting 
• Prepare reports and presentations for internal and external distribution on project progress, onboarding 
status and service performance, as per the agreed reporting calendar. 
• Track partner agencies' contractual obligations (deliverables, SLAs, penalties) and flag non -compliance 
with supporting evidence. 
• Maintain adherence to project timelines and quality of outputs, and keep version -controlled project 
documentation (BRD, FRS, UAT sign-offs, change requests) as an audit trail. 
 
Experience Criteria 
• 5+ years in software/IT project delivery, including at least 3 years as a Business Analyst or Techno -
functional lead on enterprise or citizen-facing system integration/implementation projects. 
• Working knowledge of APIs (REST/SOAP, JSON), databases (SQL) and the software development lifecycle; 
able to read API specifications (Swagger/OpenAPI) and discuss integration with developers. 
• Proficient in MS Office, MS Project and JIRA (or equivalent) for requirement, defect and task tracking; 
hands-on experience writing BRD/FRS, user stories and UAT test cases. 
• Hands-on experience with Agile development methods and practices (sprint planning, backlog grooming, 
UAT cycles). 
• Proven stakeholder management and coordination with government officials and multiple vendor/partner 
agencies. 
• Strong written and verbal communication (English and Hindi) for preparing reports and presentations for 
senior officials. 
• Must be an AI ready. All possible AI interventions must be explored.  
• Must be expert of MS suits such as Word, Excel, PPT.  
• Must have extensive working knowledge of API, its collections, postman, endpoints, encrypted responses 
etc.  
 
Desirable Certifications & Experience: 
• Prior experience of working for a government set-up/project, or on a national citizen-facing platform (e.g., 
UMANG, DigiLocker, state e-governance portals), is desirable. 
• PMP/PMI, PRINCE2 or Agile (CSM/PSM) certification is desirable.

Government, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies, are expected to apply through proper 
channel or attach a ‘No Objection Certificate’ from the employer concerned with the application OR 
produce No Objection Certificate at the time of interview.

as it deems fit.

derive any right or claim for permanent appointment at NeGD/DIC or on any vacancies existing or that 
shall be advertised for recruitment by NeGD in future.

मकान वकरार्ा भत्ता ( HRA): मकान र्कराया भत्ता भारत सरकार/भारतीय प्राणी सवेक्षण ( ZSI) क े  
लार्ू र्नयमों क े  अनुसार प्रदान र्कया जाएर्ा। र्कसी भी प्तस्थर्त में यह संबंर्ित क्षेत्र में क ें द्र सरकार क े  
कमगचाररयों को देय दरों से अर्िक नहीं होर्ा। HRA की र्णना का आ िार संबंर्ित ररसचग ि े लो को 
वास्तव में देय वजीिा (Stipend) होर्ा। 
प्रगवत ररप रा: पररयोजना ि े लो अपने कायग की प्रर्र्त क े  संबंि में र्निागररत प्रारूप में मार्सक एवं वार्र्गक 
ररपोटग, प्रिान अन्वेर्क (Principal Investigator-PI) क े  माध्यम से प्रस्तुत करेंर्े। 
ि े लोर्शप की अवर्ि समाि होने पर पररयोजना ि े लो को संपूणग कायगकाल क े  दौरान र्कए र्ए कायग की 
र्वस्तृत ररपोटग , प्रकार्शत शोि कायों/पांिुर्लर्पयों तथा पुनमुगर्द्रत प्रर्तयों ( Reprints) सर्हत, प्रिान 
अन्वेर्क क े  माध्यम से भारतीय प्राणी सवेक्षण क े  र्नदेशक को प्रस्तुत करनी होर्ी। 
शोि कायग क े  पररणामों को समकक्ष-समीर्क्षत ( Peer-reviewed) शोि पर्त्रकाओं तथा वैज्ञार्नक 
जानकारी क े  अन्य लोकर्प्रय माध्यमों में प्रकार्शत करने क े  र्लए प्रोत्सार्हत र्कया जाएर्ा। इस संबंि में 
अंर्तम र्नणगय भारतीय प्राणी सवेक्षण (ZSI) क े  र्नदेशक क े  र्ववेकार्िकार क े  अिीन होर्ा। 
शोि पत्रों में योर्दान देने वाले सभी शोिकतागओं एवं अन्य टीम सदस्ों को उनक े  योर्दान क े  अनुरूप 
उर्चत लेिकीय स्थान (Authorship) प्रदान र्कया जाएर्ा। लेिकीय अर्िकार को लेकर र्कसी र्ववाद 
की प्तस्थर्त में ZSI क े  र्नदेशक सौहादगपूणग तरीक े  से उसका समािान करेंर्े। 
ZSI में र्कए र्ए अनुसंिान से प्राि सभी प्रकाशनों में संबंर्ित र्वत्तपोर्ण एजेंर्सयों को उर्चत आभार एवं 
श्रेय (Acknowledgement) र्दया जाएर्ा। 
हालाँर्क, अनुसंिान से प्राि पररणामों क े  व्ावसार्यक उपयोर् तथा उससे संबंर्ित पेटेंट क े  अर्िकार 
पूणगतः  भारतीय प्राणी सवेक्षण (ZSI) क े  पास सुरर्क्षत रहेंर्े। 
यर्द कोई पररयोजना ि े लो र्निागररत कायगकाल की समाप्ति से पहले ि े लोर्शप छोडना चाहता/चाहती है, 
तो इसक े  र्लए भारतीय प्राणी सवेक्षण क े  र्नदेशक की पूवग अनुमर्त प्राि करना अर्नवायग होर्ा। 
यर्द भारतीय प्राणी सवेक्षण क े  र्नदेशक र्कसी ि े लो क े  कायग की प्रर्र्त अथवा उसक े  आचरण से संतुष्ट 
नहीं होते हैं, तो ि े लोर्शप समाि की जा सकती है। 
चयन प्रर्िया, िनरार्श क े  भुर्तान, आकप्तिक अनुदान (Contingent Grant) क े  उपयोर्, प्रर्र्त ररपोटग 
प्रस्तुत करने, कायगकाल, शोि प्रकाशनों, पेटेंट तथा अस्थायी अथवा सवेतन अवकाश , व्ाख्यान कायग, 
अनुसंिान, नौकरी आर्द से संबंर्ित मामलों में पयागवरण, वन एवं जलवायु पररवतगन मंत्रालय (MoEFCC) 
क े  र्नयमों क े  अनुसार SPA एवं PA पदों पर लार्ू सामान्य र्नयम प्रभावी होंर्े। 
 
भारतीय प्राणी सवेक्षण क े  र्नदेशक आवश्यकता पडने पर मुख्यालय से अर्िकाररयों को उन क्षेत्रीय क ें द्रों 
में भेज सकते हैं, जहाँ ि े लो एवं एसोर्सएट कायगरत हैं। इन अर्िकाररयों द्वारा कायग की समीक्षा, लेिा-
जोिा, उपप्तस्थर्त तथा अन्य संबंर्ित अर्भलेिों का र्नरीक्षण र्कया जा सकता है। 
ि े लोर्शप की अवर्ि क े  दौरान र्कसी भी प्रकार का सवेतन अथवा मानद, अंशकार्लक अथवा 
पूणगकार्लक रोजर्ार या र्नजी व्वसाय/प्रैप्तक्टस, चाहे वह मानद आिार पर ही क्ों न हो, अनुमत नहीं 
होर्ा। 
ररसचग ि े लो को देय वजीिा आयकर अर्िर्नयम की िारा 10(16) क े  अंतर्गत आयकर से मुक्त होर्ा।
